hero.introEntity: Muhammad Gabriel Luca Senna, lovingly called Senna or Luca, was born on 13 February 2025.
hero.description: A little soul, a growing story, and countless memories still waiting to be written.

story.title: Hello, World.
story.p1: On 13 February 2025, Muhammad Gabriel Luca Senna said hello to the world.
story.p2: This little space keeps pieces of his journey together — the ordinary days, the growing milestones, the brave moments, and everything still ahead.

brand.title: The Mark of Luca
brand.intro: This little mark was created for Luca as more than a logo. It is a gentle symbol of curiosity, growth, and the bright story still being written.
brand.narrativeIntro: The LUCA mark was created as a first personal identity for Muhammad Gabriel Luca Senna. It is a gentle symbol of who he is today and who he may become tomorrow — curious, growing, and discovering the world one step at a time.
brand.createDesc: A small nod to code, building, and the possibility of one day becoming a software engineer.
brand.wonderDesc: A spark of curiosity, possibility, and the bright spark of imagination.
brand.exploreDesc: A reminder that learning is an expanding journey, with Luca moving through life and still discovering.
brand.becomeDesc: The first line of many beginnings — Luca's first hello to the world, and perhaps one day his first line of code.
brand.valuesSubtitle: Gentle principles to guide Luca's journey, held with warmth rather than rigid expectations.
brand.valCuriousDesc: Asking questions, noticing the little wonders, and exploring with open eyes.
brand.valGrowingDesc: Learning step by step, one little discovery and milestone at a time.
brand.valBrighterDesc: Carrying warmth, curiosity, and bright possibilities forward.
brand.valPurposeDesc: Not creating for the sake of creating, but making things with care, kindness, and meaning for people.

remembrance.title: A Story That Started With Love
remembrance.p1: Before Luca's story began, there was Muhammad Alqi Parikesit — his older brother, forever part of this family and now at peace in heaven.
remembrance.p2: Today, Luca carries his own little story forward, growing one day at a time while keeping Popo and Momo company through all the ordinary moments that slowly become memories.

parentMessage.title: For Senna
parentMessage.p1: Someday you may look back at this page and see only photographs and a few words.
parentMessage.p2: For us, every one of them carries a whole memory.
parentMessage.p3: Keep exploring, keep wondering, and keep becoming your own person.
parentMessage.p4: There will always be more chapters waiting for you.

poposDream.title: Future Software Engineer
poposDream.description: For now, there are toys to explore, questions to ask, things to discover, and a whole world to understand.

hopes.title: Our Hope for Luca
hopes.headline: Choose your own path. Walk it with purpose.
hopes.pillars: Faith in your heart. Kindness in your character. Responsibility in your hands.
hopes.p1: Whatever path you choose, choose it with faith, kindness, and integrity.
hopes.p2: You do not have to be happy every day. You are allowed to feel tired. You are allowed to feel sad. You are allowed to cry. But when the moment comes, stand again and keep moving forward.
hopes.p3: Remember the faith and values you were raised with. Know what is right and what is wrong. Keep your faith close, respect others, and never let ambition make you forget your conscience.
hopes.p4: Learn what your responsibilities are. Honor your commitments. And when something becomes your duty, do your best to see it through.
hopes.p5: We do not need you to become the person we imagined. We hope you become a good man — someone who knows what he believes, treats others with kindness, understands his responsibilities, and has the courage to finish the journey he chooses.
hopes.benediction: May every step you take bring knowledge to your mind, kindness to your heart, and faith to your way.
